results.question: What is the approved guidance for 20 Percent Dial-Out SOP?
results.productionAnswer: The approved guidance for the 20 Percent Dial-Out SOP includes several key rules and procedures. Reps must not call or text outside approved hours, bypass DNC or opt-out rules, or hoard leads by working more than they can keep updated properly. No Sunday dials are allowed; dialing is permitted Monday through Saturday only. All 20 percent outbound calls must be recorded through the approved Zoom process, and reps must tell the prospect the call is being recorded for training and quality purposes and obtain acknowledgment before continuing.
